kernel.syscall.process-crash.before_comm: On both SQLite and PostgreSQL, the measured before-commit crash rolls back the incomplete-checkpoint mutation: its staged-clear interception executes, but the defective partial commit does not activate, and recovery observes no pending TurnNode while the baseline head and staging remain intact.
kernel.syscall.process-crash.after_turn_: Recovery observes that the pending TurnNode is absent and the baseline head remains intact; no durable mutant leaks the node before the head move. The shared wrapper cannot commit an independent write inside SQLite’s locked transaction.
kernel.syscall.process-crash.after_head_: Recovery observes that the pending TurnNode is absent and the baseline head remains intact; no durable mutant commits the head move before staging clear. The shared wrapper cannot commit an independent write inside SQLite’s locked transaction.
